output.reason: [ev-82ab63ec4bf8] only says the Prometheus metric cilium_node_connectivity_status is deprecated in favour of cilium_node_health_connectivity_status. No values key, flag, field or ConfigMap key controls whether an environment is exposed. Exposure depends on whether dashboards, alerting rules or queries consume that metric, and those often sit outside the product's configuration. A predicate scoped to in-cluster rule objects would also miss consumers outside the cluster, so it would be too narrow. An undecidable leaf naming exactly what is needed is therefore the right condition.
